summary: A second straight losing session ended on a firmer note: the Nifty closed off its lows, down about 0.4% in the auction after spending the afternoon in a tight range.

detail.leaders: Nifty Pharma and Healthcare (Cipla +0.98%, Sun Pharma +0.74%)
detail.laggards: FMCG, Auto, Chemicals (weakest sectors); Tata Motors PV, HDFC Life, Bajaj Finance (top Nifty losers)
detail.tone: Better than 15:00: the Nifty finished the closing auction at 22,683.75 (−96.50, −0.42%) and the Sensex at 72,480.07 (−291.65). That's about 80 pts above the 22,600 tested in the morning, and expiry passed without a late sell-off.
watch: Brent and US Treasury yields overnight
